## 简体中文

### 修复

- 恢复 Windows 风格跳转列表中运行中应用的“退出”操作，并与窗口“关闭”操作保持区分。
- 新固定的运行中应用保持在当前任务栏位置，不再立即重新分组。
- 应用退出后保留已固定图标，仅让未固定且已退出的应用触发其余任务栏项目向左收拢。

## English

### Fixed

- Restored the Quit action for running apps in Windows-style jump lists while keeping window Close actions separate.
- Kept newly pinned running apps in their current taskbar positions instead of immediately regrouping them.
- Retained pinned app icons after exit and let only unpinned exiting apps collapse the remaining taskbar items to the left.
